info.name: Macrometa API Reference Activity Metrics Manage Subscriptions API

params.name: apikey
params.description: The API key for authenticating the request

params.name: x-customer-id
params.description: ID of the customer to identify the user making the request.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of events to subscribe to. It can be local, global or collection

params.name: filters
params.description: Define the event data to be recieved via the stream based on a specific criteria. Refer to [**Event delivery filters guide**](https://www.macrometa.com/docs/photoniq/event-delivery/event-delivery-filters) for more details.

items.docs:
Subscribes to an event stream via WebSocket to recieve live updates. This API keeps the connection live and continuously receives messages from the server based on the specified query filters. 

The endpoint URL for subscribing to a stream via WebSocket follows this format: ```wss://<eds-host>/api/es/v1/subscribe``` 

Related guide: [**Subscribe to events and recieve real time updates**](https://www.macrometa.com/docs/photoniq/event-delivery/getting-started-event-delivery#subscribing-to-the-eds)

Subscribes to an event stream via SSE to recieve live updates.  This API keeps the connection live and continuously receives messages from the server based on the specified query filters. 

Related guide: [**Subscribe to events and recieve real time updates**](https://www.macrometa.com/docs/photoniq/event-delivery/getting-started-event-delivery#subscribing-to-the-eds).
